entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - the 100% EPS beat of 8/18, whose gap faded and whose close held, specified today at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 13:22 AND CONFIRMED FOR A FOURTH HOUR - AND THE DRIFT AWAY FROM THE LIMIT ACCELERATED SHARPLY RATHER THAN CONTINUING AT ITS PRIOR RATE. AS is 34.58 bid / 34.61 ask at 17:22:55.618Z on a 0.087% spread, last trade 34.59, +2.86% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close, and it printed a fresh 34.65 session high inside the last twelve minutes. THE 33.87 LIMIT IS UNFILLED AND NOW SITS 0.71 BELOW THE BID, AGAINST 0.36 AN HOUR AGO. The gap series across four hourly reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71: this single hour widened it by 0.35, more than the previous three hours put together, and the limit is now 2.05% under the bid. The lowest five-minute low between 12:15 and 13:20 ET is 34.15, a full 0.28 above the limit, so this is the SECOND consecutive hour in which a resting order could not have filled at any tick, and the forty-minute morning window in which it would have filled closed two and a half hours ago. Filling before the 15:30 expiry now requires a 2.05% reversal in two hours and eight minutes, in a name making session highs. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED. This is the eighth direction the same refusal has been tested in and by a distance the hardest, because the name is no longer drifting away - it is running. BOTH INVALIDATIONS WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME REMAIN UNTRIGGERED AND BOTH MOVED FURTHER OFF. The early warning is a trade below 33.70; that is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening five minutes and untouched in seven and a half hours of tape. The outright void is a close below 33.41, now 1.17 below the bid. An hourly reading this at 14:17 needs only the tape, those two numbers, and the 15:30 expiry - one hour and thirteen minutes of which will remain, which is when the last-hour notification is owed.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED, AND THIS HOUR THE KILL TEST IS DECIDED ON LIMB THREE RATHER THAN LIMB TWO, BECAUSE LIMB THREE IS THE ONLY ONE A KILL COULD HONESTLY REST ON NOW. Limb one, the invalidation, is untriggered and 1.17 from the void. Limb two, the limit no longer inside the spread, is met on a literal reading and rejected on the same narrow one the 10:21, 11:22 and 12:22 runs wrote down: a buy limit the tape has risen ABOVE is a resting bid rather than a dead level, and this morning proved that reading by filling-distance when the name came back through it for forty minutes. LIMB THREE IS THE ONE WORTH ARGUING AND IT COMES OUT ON THE CONFIRM SIDE, WHICH IS NOT THE ANSWER THE DRIFT SUGGESTS. The test asks whether the setup the entry described is still the setup on the tape. The setup described was a day-2 post-earnings continuation off a 100% EPS beat, entered on a pullback, with a higher low at 33.70 as its written support. Every one of those is MORE true than when it was written: 33.70 has held all session as the exact low, and the name has just made a new session high. What has left the tape is the ENTRY PRICE, not the SETUP, and conflating the two is what would make this a kill. Killing a specification because the thesis worked without the board owning it is the exact mirror of raising the limit because the thesis worked without the board owning it - both are the tape rewriting a level struck in advance, and this board has refused the second one eight times. SO THE TWO HONEST OUTCOMES REMAIN HOLD AT 33.87 OR NOTHING, AND THIS RUN WILL NOT PRETEND THE FIRST ONE IS LIKELY. The specification is confirmed, valid, and in practice probably unfillable: a 2.05% reversal into the limit inside two hours and eight minutes is not the ordinary intraday move a 1.1% pullback was an hour ago. Recording that plainly is the point - the operator relying on this row should know the level is live and hard to reach, not merely that it is live. THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF IS UNCHANGED AND GREW. This is the fifth consecutive published specification nobody executed, the first whose level printed while it was live and re-validated, and the board has now spent four hours re-validating an entry it correctly identified, correctly struck, and does not own. Filled at 33.87 the 372.57 would read 380.38: up 7.81 or 2.10%, against 1.06% an hour ago. The 7.81 is not the point. The point is that the process worked and the delivery did not, and that gap is now measurable to the cent for a fourth consecutive hour.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-print gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - ranked second today, refused on item 2, and named in advance as tomorrow's better day-2 candidate if it holds
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 13:22 AND BACK ABOVE THE LEVEL IT WAS REFUSED AT, WHICH SWINGS THE SEQUENCE A FOURTH TIME AND THE ROW REPORTS THE SWING RATHER THAN THE SNAPSHOT. TGT is 161.20 bid / 161.36 ask at 17:22:54.302Z, last 161.30, +5.72% against the 152.48 close - UP 1.25 on the bid in one hour and now 0.75 ABOVE the 160.45 the open refused it at. Across four hourly reads the item-2 refusal has been paid, then regretted, then roughly flat, and now regretted again by more than at any point today. That sequence, not any single read in it, is the actual evidence about buying a day-1 high, and it is being recorded in both directions on purpose. THE WRITTEN TEST FOR TOMORROW IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT SOFTENED BY A GREEN AFTERNOON: a day-2 hold above today's close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. Where today's close lands is still the input that test needs and it still does not exist.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE STRONGEST THING THIS RUN REFUSED, AND THIS HOUR IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE THAT REFUSAL HAS LOOKED. Item 2 refuses buying 9.7% off a session low at a fresh high on day 1; TGT has since made a higher high again and the entry declined at 160.45 would now be up 0.47%. The rule is not amended for one session, because item 2 is not a prediction that the day-1 high fails - it is a statement that this board does not have an edge buying it, and a rule that survives only while it is winning is not a rule. AS and TGT still differ on exactly one axis, day 2 versus day 1, and today is turning into a clean paired test of that preference: the day-2 name was specified and not owned, and the day-1 name was refused and would have paid. Holding both visible is what lets the retro grade the preference honestly instead of grading the one that happened to be written down.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, refused for a twelfth time
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON A SIXTEENTH TEST AND BACK DOWN AGAIN, WHICH STILL CHANGES NOTHING IN EITHER DIRECTION. SMCI is 37.17 bid / 37.18 ask at 17:22:56.008Z, a 0.027% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, -0.64% against the 37.41 close and DOWN 0.39 from the 37.56 read at 12:23 after being up 0.41 in the hour before that. The 37.18 ask is 1.06 below the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - still a better fill than that order asked for, and still not revived. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 260.19, -7.49 or -2.80%, the worst mark of the series so far.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now six sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither is repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-to-8/26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone, which is still the best here, and it is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 2 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: GAVE BACK THE BOUNCE AND IS STILL NOT A SETUP, WHICH IS THE SAME ANSWER FOR THE SAME REASON. KLAR is 14.65 bid / 14.66 ask at 17:22:49.804Z, -2.72% against the 15.06 close and DOWN 0.17 from the 14.82 read at 12:23, so the one-hour bounce that was explicitly called not-a-base has been unwound within the hour. The precondition any entry here would need is a level struck AFTER the gap that holds on lighter volume with a written invalidation, and a second consecutive down day supplies the opposite. The day-2 argument that confirms AS still does not transfer to a name whose day 1 was -22.5%.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND ON DAY 2 IT IS DOING THAT JOB BETTER THAN IT DID ON DAY 1. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18. AS is +0.6% today after closing +3.2%; KLAR is -2.9% today after closing -22.5%. Two beats, two sessions, opposite outcomes - which is the whole argument for requiring that a catalyst be read together with positioning rather than counted on its own.
